data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $75,625,000 (2021: $60,654,000) is a deterioration of $10,434,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2021: deterioration $5,306,000). The implications of this analysis have been incorporated into our reserving approach for all years of account, which together with a loading for inflation and a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates, has contributed to the back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account on a stand-alone basis.
data.standardized_narrative: At the 2022 year end Syndicate 1971 recorded adverse prior-year development. Using the gross claims development table, cumulative estimates for 2019 and 2020 increased by a combined $25.471m (13.7% of opening gross reserves of $185.473m). Management attributes the back-year deterioration to IBNR recalibration, inflationary loadings and changes in reserving assumptions/margins, together with adverse development on older accident years.
raw_causal_phrases: a deterioration of $10,434,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end
provision within claims that have been incurred at the reporting date but have not yet been reported ("IBNR")
loading for inflation and a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates
back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account on a stand-alone basis
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (columns 2019 and 2020) because the narrative explicitly states only a NET prior-year deterioration ($10.434m). The gross triangle yields a combined gross strengthening of $25.471m. Amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD).
